results.title: Release delivery and public cutover
results.summary: Implemented strict explicit scheduling intent validation for scheduled release packages and updated release tests/fixtures to supply matching timezone and wall-time intent. Added regression coverage for missing, partial, and mismatched schedule intent with no release persistence or approval/live-pointer side effects. — The core scheduling-boundary implementation matches the corrective Phase 5 requirement: scheduled releases now require explicit timezone/wall-time intent and tests cover missing, partial, mismatched, and existing valid schedule flows. Commit readiness is good for code, with only non-blocking cleanup needed around extra documentation artifacts included in the phase diff.
findings: medium/spec-deviation docs/ideation/2026-09-22-agent-publishing-studio/spec-admin-invitations.md:11 — Phase 5 diff modifies the separate Root Admin invitations spec and authorizes invitation follow-up work, while spec-phase-5 scopes this corrective rerun to release scheduling and says no invitations/provisioning authority is added → Split this admin-invitations planning change into its own reviewed phase/commit or remove it from the Phase 5 diff

results.title: Root Admin invitations
results.summary: Implemented MailManager/Symfony-based invitation mailer validation with aggregate prevalidation and expanded invitation regressions for custom/effective transports, URL overrides, malformed emails, nondefault Admin ports, custom expiry, and deterministic delivery failure retry. — The mailer validation now uses MailManager/Symfony transport resolution, handles unsafe/custom/URL/aggregate cases, and the added invitation tests cover the requested follow-up scenarios. The only issues are non-blocking scope hygiene problems from extra documentation artifacts not listed in the spec. Implementation is commit-ready once those artifacts are removed or explicitly authorized.
findings: medium/spec-deviation docs/ideation/2026-09-22-agent-publishing-studio/context-map.md:1 — Adds a planning context-map artifact that is not listed in the spec's File Changes, which only authorizes preserving run receipts/reports and the invitation/spec/test/code changes → Remove this file from the corrective commit or update the controller-owned spec to explicitly authorize it
